name: batch-84-l2-split14-r2
description: Second round of the bisect of #84's commit 14 by L2 load misses. [Round 1](../batch-84-l2-split14-r1) found two steps: about +3.3% by part 2 and about +4.8% between parts 7 and 12. Here: part 1 against part 2, and every part from 7 to 12, with c13 as the base.
dotc to `-Ystop-after:typer`, no GC inside an op, single-shot 30+16, xctrace `loads`, patched JDK 26, one fork each.

variantDescriptions.s1: after part 1 of 18: `cd3c4f2b7c` Sharing infrastructure: the Sharing mode of a ContextBase, its givens, completion lock and roots, Reader hooks + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s2: after part 2 of 18: `8f6f56510d` Stamped caches in Types and in ClassDenotation's member and base-type caches + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s7: after part 7 of 18: `524fc12e42` LazyRef and lazy annotations as Once fields + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s8: after part 8 of 18: `ddca36b15d` Types on a concurrent base: per-reader cycle breakers, rec-type openings and match-type reductions + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s9: after part 9 of 18: `2734247f5c` Denotations on a concurrent base: one-value asSeenFrom cache, ring fences, goForward in a fresh context + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s10: after part 10 of 18: `a446cb1845` Contexts and implicits: read-once implicits and related contexts with fences, per-thread search root, thread-safe implicit-scope lazies + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s11: after part 11 of 18: `d7f1306b0b` Read-once and immutable publication of lazily computed fields (ImportInfo, PerRun, FunType, SourceFile, nestedTyper, ...) + library stamps
variantDescriptions.s12: after part 12 of 18: `da8407f3d4` Completion with several readers: InProgress and ownView, root claims or the completion lock, UnwoundCompletion, inherited caches under claims + library stamps
